role: The three single-piece temples: the desert pyramid (four chests over a TNT trap), the jungle pyramid (tripwire dispensers, lever puzzle, two chests, mossy random stones) and the swamp hut (with one witch), plus the shared Feature base that settles the piece on the average ground height.
scope_reason: Temples and witch huts are vanilla worldgen and on (SPEC Decisions). Their redstone parts are placed as blocks; redstone = off only means nothing is ever powered.
